exposure: immediate intrauterine contraception device (IUCD) insertion (within 24 hours of delivery)
delayed intrauterine contraception device (IUCD) insertion (after 6 weeks of delivery)
cohort: A total of 110 women aged 18-40 years willing for intrauterine contraceptive device insertion after delivery were included.
finding: There was a significantly lower frequency of menorrhagia in women who received immediate IUCD insertion (7.27%) compared to those who received delayed IUCD insertion (25.45%).
